title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young woman with white and purple hair in buns stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-inspired outfit with a laced top, wide pants, and arm guards, surrounded by glowing purple magical energy forming crescent moons and circular runes around her hands.
prompt: A confident young woman with pale skin and long white hair tied in two buns with purple ribbons, wearing a white and purple East Asian inspired fighter outfit with laced bodice, flowing sleeves, wide pants, and ornate arm guards. She is in a martial arts stance with one hand extended forward creating glowing purple crescent moon magic and the other holding a swirling purple energy ring. Magical purple aura and sparkles surround her head and hands, solid dark gray background, clean digital painting style.
